ashamed.line: When my turn came, I was ashamed
stanza: When my turn came, I was ashamed
When my turn came, I was ashamed
Then the idiot was alone, was alone
And the water, it forgave us
And the fascists felt ashamed
At their dancing puppet king
And when you said
Of course you know
Could I be blamed
If I'd wished it so
I don't think so

named.line: I feel nervous in a way that can't be named
stanza: I feel nervous in a way that can't be named
I dreamt last night of a sign that read "The end of love"
And I remember thinking
Even in my dreaming
It was a good line for a song

unnamed.line: Because so many don't and so many go unnamed
stanza: Don't cry, child, you've got so much more to live for
Don't cry, child, you've got something I would die for
And if it comes to the rain, just be glad you'll smile again
Because so many don't and so many go unnamed
